authoring.role: Create and inspect new isolated Currency Wars Excel workbooks without patching existing files.

authority.note: openpyxl is the requested authoring adapter and does not replace Sora validation, code generation or export.

determinism.semantic_digest: SHA-256 over ordered workbook, sheet and cell values
determinism.overwrite_policy: Refuse when any target Currency Wars workbook already exists.
determinism.archive_policy: Sorted ZIP members, fixed ZIP timestamp, deflate level 9
